description: This file defines a JPA entity class 'DesktopIcon' representing an icon on a desktop, including its properties, relationships, and lifecycle callbacks.

classes.name: DesktopIcon
classes.description: A JPA entity representing a desktop icon, including properties like id, session, title, position (x, y), payload, timestamps, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: DesktopIcon
methods.description: Constructor initializing a desktop icon with session, title, position, and payload.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Payload method called before persisting, setting creation and update timestamps.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Payload method called before updating, refreshing the update timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the icon.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the desktop session for the icon.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the JSON payload associated with the icon.
